Evidence: Kashmir conflict ki shuruaat 1947 mein hui jab Pakistan ne tribal militias ke zariye Jammu aur Kashmir par hamla kiya. Iske baad India ne bhi is conflict mein shamil hua. Teen wars hue hain India aur Pakistan ke beech, jismein Kashmir ka masla hamesha samne raha. Pehli jang 1947-48 mein hui jab Pakistan ne Kashmir par kabza karne ki koshish ki, aur iske baad 1965 aur 1971 mein bhi jang hui. Har dafa Kashmir ka masla central raha hai (Source 1, Source 2).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh saaf hai ki Kashmir conflict ki shuruaat Pakistan ke tribal militias ke hamle se hui thi, aur India ne ismein shamil hote hue teen jangon ka samna kiya. Har jang mein Kashmir ka masla samne aaya, jo claim ko support karta hai. Isliye, claim ki core assertion ko evidence se support milta hai.
